risks.risk: Motor may be faulty or not working
risks.proof: A video clip showing the bike in motion with the motor engaged, or a close-up of the motor housing and wiring.

risks.risk: Tires may be worn or damaged
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tire treads and sidewalls from multiple angles.

risks.risk: Frame or components may have hidden damage or rust
risks.proof: A full 360-degree photo or video of the bike, including under the frame and around joints.

proof_requests: Close-up of the battery pack and its connectors.
Video of the bike being ridden with the motor engaged.
Close-up photos of the tire treads and sidewalls.
Full 360-degree photo or video of the bike, including under the frame.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a YGBLUN electric bike based on visible branding. The seller's claim of it being an electric bike is supported by visible battery and motor components. Hidden risks such as battery or motor functionality, tire condition, and frame damage are noted, but the item can be priced at its worst case (e.g., as not working or worn) until further proof is provided.
